verdict.rationale: Factory's droid exec is explicitly designed to run as a one-shot command in CI/CD pipelines, shell scripts, and batch jobs, which implies it can be wired to external events (e.g., git hooks, CI triggers) with tiered autonomy controlling what runs unattended — but this is an execution mode, not a native rule/trigger definition system where a user declares 'on event X, do Y'. Missing for 10: explicit rule/trigger authoring UI or config, built-in event listeners (e.g., webhook triggers, issue-created triggers), and any documented automation-rules engine beyond CI invocation.
